chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, from Abdullah ibn al-Salt, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ibn Bukayr, from Qudamah ibn Zayd, who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed the funeral prayer for his son Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and pronounced the Takbir five times over him.'
ai.seo_question: How many Takbirs did the Prophet Muhammad perform in the funeral prayer for his son Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* confirms the Prophet’s practice of offering funeral prayers for his infant son Ibrahim, establishing the five-Takbir format as a Sunnah. In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith is frequently cited to support the view that the funeral prayer consists of five Takbirs, mirroring the structure of the daily Fajr prayer, and underscores the continuity of prophetic ritual even in personal familial loss.
